sampling.tail_source_fallback_policy: After normal retries, select among all real live nodes in the already fixed start camera, weighted by residual directed-edge capacity and axis breadth. Only the soft identity/unseen source partition is bypassed; kind, length, fork, camera quota and every cap remain fixed.
sampling.start_live_axis_support_policy: Retain soft identity-count compensation, multiplied by real unsaturated distinct-axis support relative to job length. A two-axis source is neutral for L2 and softly downweighted for L5; no repeat or low-diversity session is hard rejected.
sampling.source_support_lookahead_policy: Softly prefer starts and target nodes with real unsaturated wardrobe edges serving formal single-piece slot deficits and conditional 50:50 mode deficits. Does not invent absent slots or replace source-conditioned formal expectations.
sampling.start_camera_quota_policy: Largest-remainder integer quotas over the full catalog: each of the four identity cameras has weight 1.5, every other camera weight 1. Core-coverage starts consume these same quotas. Select a camera once per job, retry within that camera, and never redistribute unsupported quota.
sampling.start_policy: exact catalog-camera quotas; soft identity balance within camera; unused nodes; residual edge support
sampling.axis_policy: legal identity=2/other=1; whole-history 0.2**n; global count feedback
sampling.core_coverage_override_policy: For missing edited attribute targets including genuinely changed-in core values, lock a real directed edge as round one of an existing fixed job; prioritize scarce incoming support, low reuse, and new-value gain. Kind, length, start-camera quota, fork round and fork source remain unchanged. Explicit coverage sampling, not pure random selection.
sampling.reuse_note: Reuse below two can result from coverage, zero/one-use preference, fixed fork jobs, and local graph support; no missing edge is invented to raise reuse.
